bio: Tucked away in the basement of the remarkable Künstlerhaus, this appealing modern restaurant also boasts a gorgeous covered terrace in the inner courtyard. The friendly team delivers an imaginative take on vegetarian cuisine (vegan options also available) in the form of a set menu, whose seven courses are only hinted at with pictures of the main ingredients. The waitstaff then proudly talk you through the dishes at your table. If you want meat or fish, you can also order a main course that suits you in advance. A range of perfectly paired cocktails and a fairly priced wine list complete the picture....
